_note: #1702/#1703/#1710 (wave 159; the operator approved, 2026-11-07): what `ops channel-page --apply` sets on the YouTube channel. `sections`: playlists shown on the page, in order, each once it has an id in data/playlists_<channel>.json - existing sections are kept, only missing ones are added. `description`: the channel's About text (under 1,000 characters; {long_slot} is the weekly long slot, e.g. 'every Sunday'). The trailer for visitors who have not subscribed is the latest public Week in Review, set by the same command.

tapin.description:
TapIn - gaming and fight news in under a minute. GTA 6, Call of Duty, Marvel Rivals, UFC, and the NFL and NBA's biggest nights: what happened, why it matters, and our call.

New Shorts every day at noon and 10 PM ET. The Week in Review, {long_slot} at 7 PM ET - the week's biggest stories in one video. Picks, graded: every call we made, scored.

Subscribe so the next big story finds you first.

Narrated with an AI voice. Every script is written from sourced reporting and checked before it goes up.
